svg.text: Concept Floor Plan and Layout Schematic
Option A shown: two dedicated blood collection rooms. Option B (one large room with clinical privacy curtain) shown in the inset.
Typical rectangle 18.5 m x 15.6 m = 288.6 sqm gross internal. Site Brief range about 257 to 290 sqm. Scale 1:100 at A1 (see scale bar).
Subject to site survey, architect and NCC compliance.
Circulation (spine, WC lobby, lounge approach, vestibule)
Total gross internal (18.5 m x 15.6 m)
Room targets come from the venue room schedule. Hair, nails, reception and the four bays are drawn slightly
below target (a 1.2 m clinical corridor and an entry vestibule use the difference). A real site and architect
may need about 300 sqm for the full schedule with no compromise. Treat all areas as indicative.
OPTION B INSET: ONE LARGE COLLECTION ROOM WITH CLINICAL PRIVACY CURTAIN
clinical privacy curtain (ceiling track, floor to ceiling)
Same footprint as Option A with the dividing wall removed.
Two chairs, one curtain-separated bay each, a handwash
basin in every bay, recovery recliner shared, specimen
fridge bay and clinical waste kept apart from the
Curtain gives visual privacy only. Sound privacy is
lower than two walled rooms (to confirm with the
pathology partner before choosing Option B).
Concept only, not for construction; subject to site survey, architect and NCC compliance. GTT Center Perth. Drawing date 2026-10-16.
